component.name: DroidDeck
component.summary: ADB command center for Android development

description.p: DroidDeck is a desktop GUI around adb and scrcpy: a live device dashboard with socket-based tracking, a logcat viewer with priority, tag, text and package filters, an app manager (install, launch, force-stop, uninstall, base and split APK extract), a device file explorer with drag-and-drop push and pull, screenshot, recording and scrcpy screen tools, wireless adb pairing with saved devices, and a real interactive shell with a quick-actions grid.
The Flatpak uses the adb and scrcpy installed on your system (for example the android-tools package), so the adb server and USB access stay with the host.
